summary.text: FUGRO NORWAY AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 1994-03-23. Fugro Norway AS provides consulting, development, equipment production and services using hydrographic, geotechnical and geophysical methods, high-performance satellite navigation and positioning, and oceanographic, meteorological and environmental measurements. It was previously named FUGRO-GEOTEAM AS until 2002-02-23. Its main industry code is 71.122: geological surveying. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 1 272 476 000 NOK and the annual result was 196 348 000 NOK; operating income was down from 1 416 945 000 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 297 039 000 NOK in 2024 to 196 348 000 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 201 967 000 NOK in 2024 to 218 315 000 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 204 on 2025-11-13 to 200 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
